scope: Saved evidence and source inspection only; no inference, runtime changes or new measurements.

v015_ar_reference.note: v0.15 MTP publication used maximum PP across prose and repetition; do not present it as separate per-workload PP.

q5_1_optimization.scope: Packed Q5_1 routed down weight loading only. Orca expert down is IQ4_NL, so its nonlinear decoder/FP32 scale path remains separate.
q5_1_optimization.causal_limit: No matched IQ4/Q4 or per-change local ablation was run; the proportion of the local/official gap explained by this change is unmeasured.

common_optimizations: Official attention and compact-selection functions match in local source; lookup is active: all eight repetitive samples record 102 lookup proposals and 102 accepted.

prefill_chunk_check.scope: AR d0 raw metrics in each local version
prefill_chunk_check.explanation: --prefill-chunk 512 is the active-decode scheduling bound, also the official default; it did not split this isolated request into four chunks.

false_meanings.same_draft_work: False for all eight repetitive formal samples: proposals, acceptance or verification rounds changed with context-copy MTP. Output hashes, finish and token/cache counts match across versions for all 24 formal samples. This does not invalidate or dismiss Prefill/TTFT latency flags.
false_meanings.formal_request_equal: Only the focused 32K control differs from the original full sweep because reduced depth history recalibrated the prompt. Original total/cached/new: 34747/32719/2028; control: 34824/32765/2059. The control old/new pair itself matches request/output/token/cache/draft work.
false_meanings.original_flag: False means a phase was newly flagged in the additional control, not a failed output check.
false_meanings.flag_5pct_and_3ms: False means no slowdown exceeding both original thresholds in that pair.

limits: Every depth has one warmed observation per version, not a replicate significance test.
Local slowdown of 1.7–5.0% is observed, not dismissed as noise or proven to be caused by the version. Existing flags and focused controls remain.
Official v0.17.1 publication uses a dirty PR production snapshot, not the exact clean tag binary.
Q4/IQ4 models, MTP weights, Linux/WSL, power and RAM budgets differ; existing absolute gaps are not attributed solely to quantization or OS.
